image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers at an incident-response desk with one plain monitor showing abstract warning symbols. A large over-ear HEADSET with a short clearly visible microphone boom lies by itself on the RIGHT foreground of the desk. Both earcups, headband and microphone boom are fully visible, no hands covering. One coworker gestures to the other to discuss roles. No phone, no text.

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅双人黑底白线火柴人，底图无文字、学习道具可辨认；完整可见的带麦克风耳麦可定位，区别于无麦克风耳机。 其他3词保持语境标签，无编造动作或身份框。 实际1254像素尺寸的裁剪检查后修正框范围，加入边缘余量保护完整道具。
